items.title: Sevastopol officials raise reported drone interception count to seven
items.summary: Sevastopol authorities said air defences and mobile units had intercepted seven drones during an ongoing attack on the Russian-controlled city, up from an earlier preliminary count of three. Governor Mikhail Razvozhaev said there were no reported injuries at that stage.

items.title: Report describes renewed drone strikes and stronger explosions in Zaporizhzhia
items.summary: A Russian military correspondent reported continuing combined strikes on the city of Zaporizhzhia, with louder explosions following an initial series of drone impacts. The account did not specify targets, casualties or damage.
